hints.title: Relative Rank Representation
hints.text: Track the relative rank of the last placed number among the numbers available so far.

hints.title: Directional Rank Transition
hints.text: When moving down (D), next rank must be smaller than or equal to current. When moving up (I), next rank must be strictly larger.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Transition Acceleration
hints.text: Accelerate the cumulative rank transitions using running prefix sums modulo 10^9 + 7 to compute each step in linear time.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of DI sequence s
complexity.notes: Relative rank transitions accelerated with running prefix sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all (N+1)! permutations takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D rolling array of size up to N + 2 consumes O(N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use relative rank state and prefix sum optimizations.
